add_heading.heading_text: 1️⃣0️⃣.How to add publications, datasets, and other outputs

add_content_to_page.add_paragraph: There are two ways to place papers on a page. **Single publications** are named by title — a title already in data/outputs/publications.json brings its whole record with it, or write the fields yourself. A **publication collection** is a reusable set kept in data/outputs/collections/ and called by its file name, so one set can appear on many pages.

add_heading.heading_text: Example: single publications
